name: Advance Grinding
verdict: Paid channels (Meta and Google Ads) show zero spend, leads, and clicks over the past 28 days, so all engagement is coming entirely from Google Business Profile, which drove 137 total actions (2 calls, 97 directions, 38 web clicks). The biggest movement is a 32.65% drop in GBP actions over the last 7 days versus the prior 7 days, likely driven by reduced search demand or a dip in profile visibility rather than any paid activity.

performance.verdict: GBP is only active channel; 3-day zero confirms organic collapse, not paid.

findings.text: OVERDUE (CRM): 4 milestones past due — 1st Directives (Jul 7), Tom call list (Jul 28), dedup workbook (Jul 31), 342 stubs (Aug 31 blocker). All CRM.
OVERDUE (Web/SEO + Outreach): 2 Aug-31 blockers unresolved — root cause fix (Web/SEO) and AGS + Forte contact pull (Outreach) both missed deadline.
GBP last 3 days (Aug 29–31) show 0 actions vs 13 avg over prior 3 days (Aug 26–28) — a confirmed 3-day signal, not noise.
GBP -32.65% week-over-week (137 total actions in 28 days); paid spend is $0 across all channels for entire 45-day series — no paid amplification possible.
GA4 sessions, Search Console clicks, and IG reach all read 0 for full 45-day window — likely tracking gaps, not true zero organic web activity.

suggestions.text: Escalate 342-stub reconciliation immediately — this is Aug-31 blocker; Sales-i pipeline blind until resolved.

Ahmed to post audited batch with rollback file to the CRM Monday board within 48 hours. Success check: all 342 stubs resolved or formally triaged by 2026-09-05.

suggestions.text: Diagnose GBP 3-day zero (Aug 29–31); confirm profile is live, no suspensions, hours/categories intact.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions dropped to 0 for three consecutive days (Aug 29–31) against a prior-3-day average of 13 actions — a confirmed signal, not noise. The 7-day delta is already -32.65%. Check profile status for suspension, verify business hours and primary category are unchanged, and confirm no ownership or verification issues. Success check: root cause identified and documented by 2026-09-03; actions return to ≥5/day within 7 days.

suggestions.text: Watch GA4/Search Console zero-read; confirm tracking is live before drawing any organic traffic conclusions.
suggestions.monday_update: GA4 sessions and Search Console clicks both report 0 across the full 45-day window, which is inconsistent with GBP web clicks (38 in 28 days) and suggests a tracking installation gap rather than true zero traffic. Dev team to verify GA4 property connection and Search Console site verification by 2026-09-05. Success check: at least directional session data confirmed flowing or gap formally documented by next check date.
